ideas.pitch: An AI-powered personalized mentor platform providing adaptive learning paths and peer collaboration matching for women in STEM.

ideas.title: AuraEdu
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages multi-agent architectures similar to recent hackathon winners, directly addressing the education and AI domains specified in the event themes.

ideas.pitch: A carbon footprint optimizer and secure transit planner for female professionals and students utilizing micro-mobility.

ideas.pitch: A non-invasive health triage and wellness tracking tool using remote photoplethysmography (rPPG) via standard smartphone cameras.

ideas.problem_statement: Software development for community problem-solving and campus logistics.
ideas.title: CampusFind AI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Integrates multimodal AI matching with location intelligence, proving immediate utility and a bulletproof live demo.
